drugRefs.why: Broad antipseudomonal carbapenem coverage is warranted given high MDR gram-negative risk in VAP; extended infusion improves pharmacodynamic target attainment in critically ill patients.

drugRefs.dose: Vancomycin 15-20 mg/kg IV q8-12h (trough-guided) or Linezolid 600 mg IV q12h
drugRefs.why: Added for empiric MRSA coverage given high prevalence of MRSA in VAP, pending culture results.

drugRefs.dose: Cefepime 2 g IV q8h + Amikacin per weight
drugRefs.coverage: Double gram-negative coverage may be used in units with high resistance rates, pending de-escalation once susceptibility is known.
Reserved for confirmed carbapenem-resistant organisms based on prior colonization or culture data - not first-line empiric.

coverageMatrix.completeness: Coverage depends heavily on local carbapenem resistance rates - confirm with unit antibiogram.
gaps: True carbapenem-resistant organisms require polymyxin/ceftazidime-avibactam-class agents based on culture data, not covered empirically.

stewardship.deescalation: Once culture and sensitivity are available, narrow to the single most targeted agent - e.g., Pseudomonas sensitive to cefepime allows discontinuation of meropenem and vancomycin if MRSA is not isolated.

framework: Double gram-negative coverage and empiric MRSA agents should be reassessed and de-escalated at 48-72 hours based on culture results.

Daily clinical reassessment for early antibiotic discontinuation is essential given high rates of antibiotic overuse in ICU settings.
